catalyst.name: Target Lock Refit, One for All Refit, Hatchling Refit, High-Impact Reserves Refit
catalyst.description:
Grants the Target Lock trait:
Successive Hits within 0.2 seconds of each grant a ramping Damage Buff after scoring 12.5% of the Magazine Capacity as hits. Missing deactivates the buff.
Stacks displayed on-screen are only visual aides, the buff ramps up with each shot once active. Reaches maximum strength at 5 Stacks.
% of the Magazine Capacity as Hits required for each Visual Stack: 12.5%|35.5%|54.5%|74.5%|110.33%
Damage Buff ramps up from 16.73% [10.46%] to 40% [25%] upon reaching maximum strength.
Assuming no missed shots, it provides roughly a 25% [15.85%] Damage Buff on average after firing 100% of the Magazine Capacity.
Grants the One For All trait:
Scoring Weapon Hits against 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each grants 35% increased damage for 10 seconds. Does not require Direct Hits.
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.
Grants the Hatchling trait:
Scoring a Precision Kill or 3 kills within 3 seconds of each other spawns a Threadling at the target's location.
Grants the High-Impact Reserves trait:
Increases damage by 12.1% [3%] to 25.6% [6%] as the Magazine drops from 50% of its base capacity to empty.
The buff in PVE ranges between 10.3% and 22.9% instead on Fusion Rifles and Aggressive Frame Linear Fusion Rifles.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

source.name: Item file barrow-dyad
source.quote: Performing a manual reload creates Blighted Seekers for 7 seconds, granting 1 Seeker for every 16.7% Blight converted.
source.note: Derived: every reload is played as a manual one. A magazine of 35 hits gives 35 x 2 % + 2 x 22 % (Taken Ambition, 12 hits each) = 114 % of Blight, so every reload makes the maximum of 6 Seekers; the 6 Seekers leave within 0.5 s of the 7 s. In the game they replace the first bullets after the reload (Aegis: at the bullets' rate); the engine knows no replaced shot, so they hit from the start of the reload: the gap to the next bullet is 0.7 s and the series of Peacekeepers holds (Aegis x1.32). The 6 replaced bullets (about 6 %) are not subtracted
